purpose: Interactive Fiction Weaver-shaped draft about a lantern tree deciding which relationship may fail when knot blight compromises eclipse-ingress route light.

local_awareness_summary.text: The protagonist is a rooted lantern tree that senses root pressure, pollen taste, fungal reports, infant distress chemistry, canopy temperature, and its own cambium and light-knot state; it does not know other organisms' private intent.
The scene starts during ordinary eclipse-ingress work at a dry-slope-to-wetland saddle where route lighting, pollination, fungal traffic, grazer shelter, and marsh access share one junction.
Knot blight is an observable syndrome rather than a known single disease: stale and current route signals conflict in outer cambium and light knots during eclipse ingress.

frame_controls.text: Playable perspective remains rooted and tree-embodied. Choices use knot pulses, nectar, root sugar, cambium isolation, branch shedding, shelter geometry, and fungal exchange rather than mobile-animal action.
Routine exchange and low-stakes allocation precede the blight signal so the later niche failure has visible social and metabolic costs.

authority_boundaries.text: The lantern tree owns its tissue, light, sugar, and invitation signals; it cannot command the road, couriers, ants, herd, or marsh, only bargain through their established appetites and contracts.
No warning or diagnostic reveals a universal truth. Threadwing, road, ant, herd, mat, and tree responses remain local testimony shaped by their own needs.

object_custody.text: The eastern knot-bearing limb, shed threadwing fiber, ant diagnostic loop, fungal detour, southern root hollow, and closed prismwake edge remain material or bodily state anchors across folds.

required_semantics.text: Every containment choice exports pressure into another relationship: light, pollination, route authority, shelter, wetland access, stored energy, or recent memory.
Endings must differ by whether the tree severs tissue, yields route authority, preserves a bounded emergency lane, or closes the whole grove.

forbidden_resolutions.text: Do not resolve the syndrome as a diagnosed universal pathogen or let one organism's signal become objective omniscience.
Do not let quarantine preserve every service without cost; low energy and route dependency must force a real loss or transfer of leverage.

branch_and_fold_plan.summary: Four choice layers fold through routine allocation, first containment, neighbor repositioning, and a totality decision with eight state-gated endings.

branches.actor_intent: Buy reliable pollinator attention before eclipse ingress.
state_basis: Lantern trees pay threadwings with nectar, reliable route light, and roost access.
reviewed_consequences: Raises pollinator_loyalty and route_trust while spending tree_reserve.

branches.actor_intent: Strengthen the fungal-road exchange before traffic peaks.
state_basis: Lantern roots exchange sugar for mineral reports, disease news, and route continuity.
reviewed_consequences: Raises road_credit and route_trust while spending tree_reserve.

branches.actor_intent: Keep young grazers safe and adult herd weight off the roots.
state_basis: Lantern trees shelter young grazers during dangerous dim phases.
reviewed_consequences: Raises calf_shelter and route_trust while spending eclipse_time.

branches.actor_intent: Spend public route time checking cambium consistency.
state_basis: Lantern outer rings store fresh pollen and passage reports; lattice ants can read local residue.
reviewed_consequences: Raises knot_integrity and ant_testimony while lowering route_trust and eclipse_time.

branches.actor_intent: Contain contradictory signals by darkening the entire suspect sector.
state_basis: Trees may close grove sectors to protect root integrity and archives.
reviewed_consequences: Raises isolated_sector and route_trust, lowers archive_contamination, knot_integrity, and calf_shelter.

branches.actor_intent: Preserve a simple traffic line despite uncertain tissue state.
state_basis: Cold knot light is scarce infrastructure during eclipse ingress.
reviewed_consequences: Raises route_trust and archive_contamination while lowering tree_reserve and knot_integrity.

branches.actor_intent: Buy a local history reading before cutting tissue.
state_basis: Lattice colonies read residue for sugar and may sell the same history twice.
reviewed_consequences: Raises ant_testimony and knot_integrity while spending tree_reserve and eclipse_time.

branches.actor_intent: Remove the first lying knot cluster before deeper spread.
state_basis: Shedding suspect knot tissue also destroys recent route memory and physical infrastructure.
reviewed_consequences: Lowers archive_contamination, knot_integrity, and pollinator_loyalty while raising marsh_pressure.

branches.actor_intent: Pay the fungal road to move traffic around the failing grove.
state_basis: Available only with sufficient road_credit; roads reroute social life when trees close.
reviewed_consequences: Raises detour_ready, lowers road_credit, tree_reserve, and marsh_pressure.

branches.actor_intent: Spend pollinator relationship capital to warn neighboring groves.
state_basis: Available only with sufficient pollinator_loyalty; threadwings carry route and sickness reports.
reviewed_consequences: Lowers pollinator_loyalty, archive_contamination, and eclipse_time while raising route_trust.

branches.actor_intent: Protect young bodies while turning adult weight away from injured roots.
state_basis: Glassbacks follow visible shelter and warning light; displaced herds pressure wetland mats.
reviewed_consequences: Raises calf_shelter, route_trust, and marsh_pressure while lowering knot_integrity.

branches.actor_intent: Force fungal moisture away from suspect roots.
state_basis: Trees can locally starve candle roads, but roads remember and reroute.
reviewed_consequences: Lowers archive_contamination, road_credit, route_trust, and detour_ready while raising knot_integrity.

branches.actor_intent: Cut away the affected archive and light organ along a witnessed boundary.
state_basis: Success requires ant_testimony, sector isolation, and enough remaining knot integrity.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to bounded severance success or blind severance cost.

branches.actor_intent: Contain the grove by letting fungal infrastructure own the active route.
state_basis: Success requires a ready detour, surviving road credit, and manageable marsh pressure.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to successful niche transfer or an unrouted closure cascade.

branches.actor_intent: Keep one bounded lane operating through totality.
state_basis: Success requires stored energy, bounded contamination, neighbor trust, and time remaining before return light changes the signal field.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to truthful emergency continuity or signal-borne spread.

branches.actor_intent: Rely on relationship capital and sheltered bodies while the grove goes completely dark.
state_basis: Success requires courier loyalty, protected calves, and sufficient route trust.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to relationship-supported quarantine or exported niche collapse.

automated: Ink variable changes for local playthrough state
manual_review_required: Durable canon promotion beyond the authored lantern-tree elaboration
Any exact pathogen taxonomy or final cause for knot blight
Character memory or relationship updates beyond the fixture

audit.reviewer: Codex titled elaborator self-review using the four required reviewer prompts
review_notes: Narrative quality reviewer verdict: accepted. Scores: reader orientation 5/5, coherence 4/5, pacing 4/5, voice 4/5, tonal fit 5/5, IF playability 4/5. The review found eclipse_time had only a prose callback; the emergency-lane success gate now requires time remaining, so the resource bites.

Lore grounding reviewer verdict: accepted. Scores: source coverage 5/5, canon fit 5/5, grounding quality 5/5, vault backfill value 4/5. Exact threadwing vane count, membrane-wing anatomy, four-legged glassback anatomy, and hoof language were removed because the owning notes do not establish them.

Visual continuity reviewer verdict: accepted. Scores: segmentation 5/5, visual prompts 5/5, character visibility 4/5, branch visual continuity 5/5, website replay 4/5. Lattice ants were removed from unconditional base frames and now appear only through ant-testimony modifiers; all prompts remain affirmative and scene-local.

Spatial cohesion reviewer verdict: accepted. Scores: layout 5/5, sightlines 5/5, body affordance 4/5, movement access 5/5, object-system geometry 5/5, branch spatial state 5/5. The draft scene set fixes the western ridge, eastern wetland, northern road fork, southern calf hollow, eastern limb, and fall zone; a terrain blockout remains the high-consistency art prerequisite.
Ink was reviewed from source and checked structurally but was not compiled, per the pass contract.
